problems.question:
$z^3 - 3z^2 + 4z - 12 = 0$ is a cubic equation with real coefficients.
Given that $2i$ is a root, find all the roots.

lines.text: The coefficients are real, so complex roots come in conjugate pairs.

steps.title: Find the quadratic factor from the pair

lines.text: Sum of the pair, then product of the pair.

steps.title: Divide to find the linear factor

lines.text: Compare constant terms: $4 \times (\text{constant}) = -12$, so the constant is $-3$.

problems.question:
Fabric costs €$5.25$ per metre.
Find the exact cost of $24.8$ metres of the fabric.
By rounding each number to the nearest whole number, estimate the cost and check that your answer is sensible.

lines.text: The estimate €$125$ is close to the exact cost €$130.20$, so the answer is sensible.

problems.question:
The function $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is defined by $f(x) = 7 - 4x$.
Prove that $f$ is injective.

steps.title: Assume two inputs give the same output

lines.text: $f$ is injective if $f(a) = f(b)$ forces $a = b$.
Different inputs always give different outputs, so $f$ is injective.

workedSolution.finalAnswer: f(a) = f(b) \Rightarrow a = b \text{, so } f \text{ is injective}

problems.question:
$A$, $B$ and $C$ are points on a circle and $[AB]$ is a diameter.
$|AC| = 6$ cm and $|BC| = 8$ cm.
Find the length of the diameter $|AB|$.

steps.title: Use the angle in a semicircle

lines.text: $[AB]$ is a diameter, so the angle at $C$ on the circle is a right angle.
